constraints: Keep go.mod and go.sum consistent: after the change no package should still require github.com/cncf/udpa/go, directly or through a replace directive.
Check github.com/cncf/xds/go for API differences before switching; it may not be a drop-in replacement for every github.com/cncf/udpa/go call.

steps.instructions: Replace the github.com/cncf/udpa/go requirement with github.com/cncf/xds/go (`go get github.com/cncf/xds/go@latest`), then run `go mod tidy`.
steps.title: Replace the deprecated module

steps.instructions: Update imports and calls of github.com/cncf/udpa/go in the reported files to github.com/cncf/xds/go.
steps.title: Migrate imports and calls

verification.purpose: Build and test every package without the deprecated module.

verification.command: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
verification.purpose: Confirm go.mod and go.sum are tidy after the replacement.

rule.summary: The latest github.com/cncf/udpa/go module declares: "use github.com/cncf/xds/go instead."
rule.title: github.com/cncf/udpa/go is deprecated
